facts: Patrick Collison is an Irish entrepreneur, investor, and philanthropist born on September 9, 1988.
He co-founded the payment processing company Stripe with his brother John Collison in 2010.
He won Ireland's Young Scientist and Technology Exhibition in 2005 at the age of sixteen.
He co-founded the nonprofit research organization Arc Institute in 2021 with Silvana Konermann and Patrick Hsu.
He joined the board of directors of Meta Platforms in April 2025.
He married Swiss-American biochemist Silvana Konermann in April 2022.
